Posted 'DV w/saber' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'DVDLOTS' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'darth vaders LS' dested Vader's Lightsaber; 'Maras LS' dested Mara Jade's Lightsaber.
Posted 'Darth maul w/saber' x3 dested Darth Maul With Lightsaber, a Theed Palace card (set released 12 December 2001, after this 11 October 2001 post); kept as posted.

Posted 'podracing arena', 'boonta eve podrace', 'death star DB' and 'tatooine DB' dested the Dark printings; 'executor DB' dested Executor: Docking Bay; 'IAO/Secret plans' dested Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans.
The 'guys' header line was dropped. The strategy says the author later swapped a Force Lightning and a Vader's Obsession for 2 Holonet Transmissions; the list is kept as posted.
